physiology:
The traditions place this code in the blood, in the warm liquid weather running under the skin. Not a single organ but a moving tide, in every limb at once, the body's own inland sea reporting on itself moment by moment. Fitting, that the code about being at home in a body lives in the part of the body that has no fixed address.

The shadow has its floor here. Seriousness is not really a thought, it is a temperature. The blood runs a little cooler when the day is being managed instead of lived. The shoulders set. The breath shortens. Hands go to the gripping shape they spend most of the year in. Touch becomes something to ration, and the warm tide pulls back from the surface and pools somewhere deeper, somewhere harder to reach. People feel it in themselves as a low chill they can never quite name.

The climb out is the same tide coming back. Warmth at the cheeks. The breath dropping lower. A loosening in the hands before the mind has decided anything. Food tastes like something. Skin remembers it is allowed to be touched. The body, which had been holding itself off from its own life, lets the blood back into the places it had been kept out of. The teaching is not difficult once the body agrees to it. It runs in the part of you that was already trying to come home.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the blood, this code answers to a single amino acid, Alanine. Alanine belongs to the small group the body makes for itself. It is not taken in from outside, it is built from the body's own working chemistry, mostly out of what muscle is doing as it moves. The body manufactures it, carries it through the blood to the liver, and uses it to keep the day's fuel steady.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the quiet companion to all the worry of the shadow. The code about luck, about delight, about being in the right place at the right time, runs on a chemistry the body already makes. The supply is not in question. It is being produced, right now, by the simple fact that you are alive and moving. Nothing has to be earned. Nothing has to be taken in. The fuel for delight is being assembled inside you, in the dark, while you stand here being serious about whether you deserve it.

The code runs all the way down to this: a chemistry that was always going to be enough.
